text: The Public Investment Fund holds a 22.55 percent stake in Bahri (National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia) and 20 percent is held by Saudi Aramco Development Company, with the remainder in public shares.
short: PIF holds 22.55% of Bahri; Saudi Aramco Development Company holds 20%.
